nifdebug 0.1.3
  • Reference

    Interactive debug plot for NIF objects

    nif_debug.Rd

    Launches a Shiny app that renders an interactive version of [nif::plot.nif()]. The app includes a subject (`USUBJID`) filter above the plot; the default is all subjects. Next to the selector, available subject fields from the NIF (`ID`, `SEX`, `AGE`, `WEIGHT`, `DL`) are shown when a single subject is chosen. Data points are clickable; clicking a point displays the corresponding source SDTM record in a table below the plot.

    nif_debug(
  nif,
  sdtm = NULL,
  analyte = NULL,
  dose = NULL,
  time = "TAFD",
  color = NULL,
  facet = "DOSE",
  min_time = NULL,
  max_time = NULL,
  cfb = FALSE,
  dose_norm = FALSE,
  log = TRUE,
  lines = TRUE,
  size = 2,
  alpha = 1,
  scales = "fixed",
  base_size = 16
)

    Arguments

    nif

    A nif object. If it contains `SRC_DOMAIN` and `SRC_SEQ`, clicking points enables SDTM source lookup and will display the SDTM tables.

    sdtm

    An optional `sdtm` object used to look up source records. If `NULL` (or missing the required NIF source fields), the SDTM/EX tables are hidden.

    analyte

    The analyte(s) to be plotted, as character.

    dose

    The dose(s) to be filtered for.

    time

    The time field for the x-axis. One of 'TIME', 'NTIME', 'TAFD' or 'TAD'.

    color

    The column(s) to be used for coloring.

    facet

    The column(s) to be used for faceting.

    min_time

    The minimal time, as numeric.

    max_time

    The maximal time, as numeric.

    cfb

    Plot change from baseline, as logical.

    dose_norm

    Dose-normalized values, as logical.

    log

    Logarithmic y axis, as logical. Defaults to `TRUE` (Log checked in the app).

    lines

    Plot lines, as logical.

    size

    The `size` parameter to [ggplot2::geom_point()], as numeric.

    alpha

    The `alpha` parameter to [ggplot2::geom_point()], as numeric.

    scales

    The `scales` parameter to [ggplot2::facet_wrap()].

    base_size

    Base font size as numeric.

    Value

    A Shiny app object.

    Details

    Source lookups are only available when: - `sdtm` is provided, and - the NIF includes `SRC_DOMAIN` and `SRC_SEQ`.

    If SDTM lookup is not available, the upper SDTM/EX tables are not shown, but the NIF record table can still be displayed.

    `SRC_DOMAIN` and `SRC_SEQ` are typically present when the NIF is built with `debug = TRUE` or when the global `nif::nif_option("debug")` is set.

    See also

    [nif::plot.nif()], [nif::nif_viewer()]
